title: Apache superset: aiohttp is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python (CVE-2024-23334)
description: CVE-2024-23334 is a high-severity security vulnerability affecting the apache-superset package, related to the aiohttp asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. The vulnerability allows remote network attackers to cause a high impact on confidentiality without requiring privileges or user interaction. Fixed versions 2021.36.5-r0 and 2021.38.2-r0 address this issue.
